notes: Exact requested 2D/200% failure original 1A0CB96E-19D3-47D8-8D72-BEC8B875D34F.png was viewed directly at original resolution. It shows Your turn · claim Crowns, five covered cards, complete Reveal my hand and Call the bluff controls, and the disabled Choose cards to play action. The YOUR HAND heading clips at the upper scroll edge; round context is above the viewport. No private faces/rank labels are exposed. The visible image does not override the current-bounded-diagnostics test failure.

Secure Exit original 6CFF04E3-5306-465E-B3C7-58FE0849238C.png was viewed directly at original resolution. It shows Table closed, the relaunch instruction, Host +1 and Closed status; the Godot surface is absent. This matches the specific secure default Exit/cleanup receipt without qualifying a full secure match or retained-engine lifecycle.
No transformed derivative of either directly viewed original was created by the gallery review.

iOS 2D/200% initial concealed capture shows a complete Reveal my hand button; the lower Choose cards control clips. Revealed-and-selected shows Moon selected with check/outline, a complete Crown and a clipped next card; the five-card hand is horizontal scroll content.

Cover and resumed originals remove private ranks/faces/selection and retain complete Reveal. Native Pause presents an opaque cover; the separate actual Home screenshot visibly shows SpringBoard with dock icons.

iOS 2D/200% after-play/public-outcome captures show round 1, Bluff caught, public Moon and the named Moxie/Ari Star challenge. Remaining consequence and Next action are below the screenshot viewport. These pictured checkpoint states do not override the later diagnostics failure at round 4/revision 10 with three actual Next taps.

iOS 2D/100% initial Reveal is clipped at the lower edge of the concealed-hand panel. The selected screenshot has three complete card controls (Moon selected and two Crowns) in a horizontal hand, plus complete Claim 1 Star and Call the bluff controls. Later covered/resumed frames fit Reveal in full.
Native Pause shows an opaque cover. The actual normal-2D Home image visibly shows SpringBoard and dock icons; the resumed frame shows no private hand faces, per-card labels or selection.

Normal-2D round-1 outcome frames show the complete named Moxie/Ari Star challenge, public Moon, light-1 Still in consequence and complete Deal the next round control. Lower seat rows remain below the scroll viewport.

The normal-2D winner screenshot shows Orbit at round 14, public Moon, Moxie's Crown claim, light-4 burnout and complete Return to lobby. The original reference test still fails its 42-versus-41 revision assertion; the screenshot does not qualify the failed test as passing.

iOS 3D/200% has full pinned Show/Hide, Star table · round 1 and Your turn context. The enlarged selected frame shows complete Selected · Moon and two Crown controls plus one Star; the fifth control continues below. Visual table cards clip at the top of the scroll viewport.

Cover and resumed 3D/200% frames show only backs with no private per-card controls or selection, plus complete Show hand and disabled Select cards. Native Pause uses an opaque cover; actual Home shows SpringBoard and dock icons.

3D/200% round-1 after-play/public-outcome frames show complete named Moxie/Ari Star challenge, light-1 Still in consequence and Moon · Doesn't match. The public card/table clips at the bottom and Next is below the screenshot viewport.

The two 3D/200% outcome PNGs pair with round-1/revision-2 checkpoints. The retained three later Next touches and later app-stream progress remain separate from these pictured checkpoints; the original controlMissing test result remains failed.

iOS 3D/100% fits the pinned Show/Hide control, turn/rank/round context, all five normal-size card faces and rank words, and complete Play 1. Selected Moon has a check and outline. The seat roster still scrolls horizontally and clips the rightmost statistics.
Normal-3D Cover/resume removes all private faces, labels and selection; native Pause shows an opaque cover and actual Home shows SpringBoard with dock icons.

Normal-3D after-play/public-outcome frames show complete named Moxie/Ari Star challenge, light-1 Still in consequence, public Moon mismatch and complete Next round. These are round-1/revision-2 screenshot checkpoints; the later recorded Next touch and control-enabled failure remain separate evidence.
